items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Well, David Jones was the most outstanding saxophone player.

ctx.x: I only got the news. Yeah. He's dead. Yeah. And what about saxophone players then? Do they have any good saxophone players?
Well, David Jones was the most outstanding saxophone player. Back in those times you're talking about.
Yeah, wasn't he just 1925 that time?
